single.rationale: Hasbro shows encouraging operational improvements (strong FCF generation, cost-savings execution, record MAGIC: THE GATHERING performance) but faces significant headwinds including a $1B goodwill impairment, net loss in FY2025, collapsing operating margins (0.2%), and material tariff exposure ($45M in costs with ongoing uncertainty). The 13% revenue growth masks a brutal three-year -7% CAGR from $6.7B to $4.7B, suggesting a business still in turnaround mode rather than sustainable expansion.

team.thesis: Hasbro presents a high-risk concentration play trading at 15.1x free cash flow, where a $641.5M surge in MAGIC: THE GATHERING and $168.0M in MONOPOLY GO! licensing drove all revenue recovery to $5.4B (up 13.1%), masking 4.6% and 13.7% declines in Optimize and Reinvent Brands respectively, while operating margin collapsed to 0.2% ($11.1M operating income) despite nearly $800M in cost savings, hampe

dropped.claim: The thesis valuation of 15.1x free cash flow relies on $829.9M FCF in 2025, but this figure is dramatically inflated by abnormally low capex of $63.3M (just 1.2% of revenue), down from $128.2M in 2022 and $87.2M in 2024. This represents potential under-investment in the business during a supposed 'turnaround', raising questions about sustainability of the FCF figure used for valuation.
